strategy.text:
(1) ATTACK? Pelipper likely Scald/Hurricane/U-turn. As a rain setter that just pivoted in, it likely U-turns (to a Swift Swim abuser I haven't seen) or clicks Scald/Hurricane to pressure Weezing. Confidence moderate (~50% U-turn, ~35% Scald/Hurricane, ~15% Roost/other). Key: Scald in rain is 2x/OHKO-risk on Rotom-Heat but only 1x on Toxtricity; Hurricane is 1x on both.
(2) SWITCH? Could U-turn out to an unrevealed Swift Swim teammate. Cannot predict which.
(3) THEIR READ OF ME: only Weezing-Galar revealed. It does not know my Electric answers.
(4) MY OPTIONS & COST: Switching to Toxtricity (Electric/Poison) threatens a guaranteed Wild Charge OHKO on Pelipper (4x, I outspend at 249 vs ~229). Cost vs Rotom-Heat: Toxtricity takes Scald at 1x (survives) whereas Rotom-Heat takes 2x (~93.8% OHKO) — so Toxtricity is the safer switch. Cost: forfeit turn, eat the hit; Toxtricity also eats Wild Charge recoil + Life Orb (drops to ~35-40% HP after killing). Gain: removes their Drizzle rain and a pivot. Even if Pelipper U-turns, U-turn is 0.5x on Toxtricity (negligible) and Toxtricity is a live Shift Gear threat vs whatever comes in. Not behind; this is a steady, high-reward line. Weezing attacking (Sludge Bomb/Strange Steam 1x) is weaker tempo and does not threaten a kill.
(5) MOST LIKELY + RESPONSE: Pelipper U-turns or Scalds. My Toxtricity switch survives both (U-turn 0.5x, Scald 1x) and threatens the OHKO. Falsifier: if Pelipper had a move that 2HKOs Toxtricity while also being faster would be bad — it is slow, so no.
(6) SEQUENCE: Pelipper acts (Scald/U-turn/Hurricane) -> Toxtricity switches in, takes ~1x or 0.5x -> next turn I Wild Charge (OHKO) unless Pelipper switched out via U-turn, in which case I decide vs the new mon (Toxtricity can Shift Gear or attack).

(2) SWITCH? Opponent just manual-switched in Pelipper this turn, unlikely to switch again immediately; may U-turn out later.

Toxtricity (Wild Charge OHKO, takes Scald 1x) is safer vs Scald but lacks a Scarf and recoils. Weighing: defensive Pelipper (most common alongside a bulky Claydol partner) usually runs NO Scald, making Rotom-Heat switch nearly free and instantly winning the matchup. I'm not behind; this is a proactive winning line.
(5) MOST LIKELY + RESPONSE: Pelipper uses Hurricane or U-turn; I switch Rotom-Heat, survive comfortably, and OHKO next turn. Falsifier: if a rain-boosted Scald hits and OHKOs Rotom-Heat (reveals Specs + Scald).
